node.label: Focal T2 hyperintense thalamic lesion
node.definition: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.

evidence.snippet: Leukoencephalopathy with dystonia and motor neuropathy: Focal T2 hyperintense thalamic lesion (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
